T: One acorn. One very long chase.
D: A mammoth, a sloth and a sabre-tooth tiger team up to return a human baby to his father.
P: Serve the snacks when the dodos fight over the last melon.
S: the dodos defending their last melon
Watermelon cut into thick wedges, topped with crumbled feta, torn mint, lime and a pinch of flaky salt, served very cold.
the squirrel and his one acorn
Hazelnut and chocolate truffles rolled in chopped toasted hazelnuts, a pretzel stick pushed in as the stalk so they look like acorns.
M: big food for a woolly mammoth
Beef short ribs rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, wrapped and baked at 150C for 4 hours, glazed under the grill with barbecue sauce. Coleslaw.
Sid's root vegetable and lentil stew
Sid, the sloth who eats plants

Carrot, parsnip, pumpkin and brown lentils simmered with tomato, smoked paprika and thyme until thick, with crusty bread and a dollop of herby yoghurt. Soften 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves and 2 diced celery sticks in olive oil. Add 2 carrots, 1 parsnip and 500g pumpkin, all in chunks, with 1 tsp smoked paprika and thyme. Add 200g rinsed brown lentils, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 1 litre vegetable stock and simmer 35 minutes until thick. Stir in a handful of baby spinach. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread.
W: Vanilla cupcakes covered in marshmallow frosting and rolled in desiccated coconut so they look like snowballs.
K: the one acorn Scrat never lets go of
Vanilla ice cream blended with milk, caramel and peanut butter into a thick nutty shake.

s.note: the squirrel and his one acorn
s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate, stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into small ovals and coat the bottom half in 100g chopped toasted hazelnuts. Push a short piece of pretzel rod in the top as the stalk.

s.note: the dodos defending their last melon
s.how: Cut 1.5kg watermelon into thick wedges and chill well. Crumble 100g feta over the top, scatter torn mint leaves, squeeze over 1 lime and finish with a pinch of flaky salt. Serve very cold.

m.note: big food for a woolly mammoth
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with salt, pepper and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 4 hours. Unwrap, brush with 150ml barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill. Shred a quarter cabbage with mayo for slaw.

w.how: Bake 12 vanilla cupcakes from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour at 180C for 18 minutes. Melt 200g marshmallows with 2 tbsp water and spread over the tops. Roll in 100g desiccated coconut so they look like snowballs.

d.note: the one acorn Scrat never lets go of
d.how: Blend 600ml cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 3 tbsp caramel sauce and 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter until thick. Pour into 4 glasses and drizzle a little extra caramel on top.
